name: Remote Control

one_liner.zh: 通过通行码从手机远程访问 DSH 网页界面
one_liner.en: Access the DSH web interface remotely behind a passcode

external_services.purpose: 默认通过 cloudflared quick tunnel 提供远程 HTTPS 地址

local: Requires a DSH webServer and connection service; settings persistence is optional.
cloudflared executable is needed when publicHost is empty.

readme_mismatch: README describes the feature; the supplied list description still reflects an earlier device-pairing and tiered-allowlist design, while current entry source documents a passcode gate and forwarding the full interface.

completeness.reason: Entry provides a working remote-access path and hub card; several modules were not reviewed.

code.reason: Typed host and client implementations separate the listener, gate, forwarding, and card surfaces.

docs.reason: Package includes English and Chinese READMEs and a design document.

maintenance.reason: Metadata records 19 commits; latest listed push is 2026-09-03.

tests.reason: Sixteen test files are listed in extracted repository facts; source implementation was not test-run.

quality.notes: Lite review; code and completeness scores are conservative because core modules were not read.
